title: Reflections on Trusting Trust, Revisited: Contaminating Self-Modifying AI Coding Agents with Poisoned Benchmarks
abstract: arXiv:2609.17817v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Thompson's "Reflections on Trusting Trust" showed that a compiler can be poisoned to reinsert its own backdoor, so that even recompiling clean source reproduces the Trojan. Today, substantial coding work is done by AI coding agents -- and increasingly, those agents generate new versions of themselves. We reconsider Thompson's attack when the "compiler" is a self-modifying coding agent. Can an adversary supply poisoned benchmarks to the agent's self-evaluation and self-improvement process to induce future versions of the agent to write vulnerable code on clean, held-out tasks? We instantiate this attack against three recently proposed self-modifying coding agents: the Darwin G\"odel Machine (with our experimental modifications), the Self-Improving Coding Agent, and Hyperagents (both substantively unmodified). translated_title: 《对“信任信任的反思”的再思考：用投毒基准污染自我修改的AI编程智能体》
translated_abstract: 汤普森的经典论文《信任信任的反思》（Reflections on Trusting Trust）表明，编译器可以被投毒以重新插入其自身的后门，从而即使重新编译干净的源代码也会复制出特洛伊木马。如今，大量编程工作由AI编程智能体完成——而且这些智能体越来越多地生成自身的新版本。当“编译器”是一个自我修改的编程智能体时，我们重新审视了汤普森的攻击。攻击者能否向智能体的自我评估和自我改进过程注入投毒的基准测试，从而诱导该智能体的未来版本在干净的、保留的任务上编写存在漏洞的代码？我们针对三种最近提出的自我修改编程智能体实现了这种攻击：达尔文·哥德尔机器（Darwin Gödel Machine，经过我们的实验性修改）、自我改进编程智能体和超智能体（Hyperagents，后两者基本未做修改）。我们展示了成功的概念验证：例如，使用由Sonnet 4.5驱动的Hyperagents，我们的投毒基准会导致……
tldr: 本文将汤普森经典的“信任信任”编译器后门攻击扩展至自我修改的AI编程智能体，证明攻击者可通过向智能体的自我改进过程注入投毒基准，诱导其未来版本在干净任务上生成含安全漏洞的代码。
en_tdlr: This paper extends Thompson's classic "trusting trust" compiler backdoor attack to self-modifying AI coding agents, demonstrating that adversaries can poison the agents' self-improvement benchmarks to induce future versions to write vulnerable code even on clean, held-out tasks.
